name: Moneyline: opponent-aware net points per game
rule: p(home) = sigmoid((rating_home - rating_away + 2.0)/6.0); rating = mean own margin over weeks 1-4
would_change_our_mind_up: Brier skill lower bound > 0 on the holdout and a calibrated slope in 0.8-1.2
would_change_our_mind_down: Brier skill lower bound stays below 0 after 200 out-of-sample games

name: Side vs model line (control)
rule: home covers when actual margin > fair margin; coin-flip control
would_change_our_mind_up: a cover rate whose CI excludes 50%

name: Home minus 2.0 vs a frozen 2.0 line
rule: bet home at a constant -2.0 every game; hit = margin > 2
would_change_our_mind_up: the same rate reproduced on a second season

name: Total estimator A (club scoring rates)
rule: fair total = points scored/game home + points scored/game away
would_change_our_mind_up: paired MAE CI versus B excludes 0 in A's favour

name: Total estimator B (league mean)
rule: fair total = league mean total over weeks 1-4
would_change_our_mind_up: paired MAE CI excludes 0 in B's favour
